messages:
maya: Hey design folks — quick synchronous review? I pushed a compact flow for the Pool + SLO controls. Need accessibility check and copy tweaks. Sketch: https://redwood.design/s/compact-pool-slo

maya: Key ask: make sure keyboard nav between pool picker, min/max steppers, and burst selector is obvious. Also SLO slider guardrail copy is terse but might be ambiguous.

derek: taking a look now. Can you paste the current copy here so reviewers don't have to open the sketch?

maya: sure

maya: "SLO target — choose a latency budget that matches your application. Higher SLO = more capacity and cost." -> maybe too vague

sophia: suggestion: "Latency SLO — target median request latency. Raising this reduces errors but increases cost." short + explicit

aisha: +1 to sophia. Also we should label units: ms (median)

sophia: UI nit: the SLO slider currently allows 0-3000 with no ticks. We should add preset chips: 50ms, 200ms, 500ms, 1500ms

derek: Accessibility: color contrast for the selected burst badge is borderline on 14px labels. @design-bot can you run contrast check?

design-bot: Contrast report: selected-burst-bg (#DADEEF) on text (#0B1A2B) = 3.8:1. Fails AA for normal text. Recommend darker bg or bold text.

maya: hmm ok. Options: darken bg to #C0D6FF or set text to 16px semibold. Thoughts?

aisha: prefer darker bg so we don't change typographic rhythm

sophia: keyboard flow: when tabbing from pool picker, focus lands on the min stepper increment button. Users expect to land on the numeric input first. Can we re-order tabindex?

derek: agree. Also add aria-labels for the compact steppers. Example:

```html
<button aria-label="Decrease min GPU count" ...>-</button>
<input aria-label="Min GPU count" value="1" />
<button aria-label="Increase min GPU count">+</button>
```

maya: good. Also need to ensure screen reader announces burst policy: e.g., "Burst: enabled — max 10 GPUs" rather than just "On"

sophia: copy tweak for burst tooltip: "Burst temporarily increases pool capacity to handle short traffic spikes. Billed at usage rate." shorter: "Temporarily scale pool during spikes. Billed by usage."

derek: on the pool picker: we display pool name and region; add throughput badge? Some PMs requested per-pool baseline throughput so teams choose correctly

aisha: maybe show estimated qps in small text under the name

maya: decision items:
1) change SLO slider presets + add unit label
2) fix contrast on burst badge (darken bg)
3) reorder keyboard tab flow so numeric inputs get focus first
4) add aria labels for steppers and burst state
5) add small throughput estimate under pool name

maya: anyone object to shipping these as minor patch this week? :eyes:

sophia: no objections from design side

derek: eng can do 1-4 this week, 5 depends on backend data. Can we default to "est: unknown" if data missing?

aisha: yes default to tertiary text "est: unknown" and show spinner while fetching

maya: sweet. I'll update the figma and drop a PR with the text changes. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sophia: leaving a11y TODO in Figma: keyboard order + aria map

derek: ping me on the PR, I'll add tests for focus order

aisha: I'll prepare copy variants for QA to test with screen reader

maya: end
